verses.english: Passion & aversion come from what cause? Displeasure, delight, horripilation are born from what? Arising from what do thoughts fling the mind around, as boys, a (captive) crow? The Buddha: Passion & aversion come from this as a cause; displeasure, delight, horripilation are born from this; arising from this thoughts fling the mind around, as boys, a (captive) crow: They’re born from affection arisen from the mind, from oneself, like the trunk-born (shoots) of a banyan tree, thick, attached to sensuality, like a māluva vine spread in a forest. Those who discern where it’s born drive it out—listen, yakkha! They cross over this flood, so hard to cross, never crossed before, for the sake of no further becoming.
